rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Soap making (saponification): fat + NaOH → glycerol + sodium stearate; soap = RCOO−Na+ with hydrophobic tail + hydrophilic head — draw the micelle.  ·  Trick 2: Soap fails in hard water: Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ form insoluble scum (RCOO)2Ca — this single line is WHY detergents were invented.
